blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) on Monday summoned Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan to formally protest his remark that China could “easily win” a confrontation with the Philippines, calling it “provocative and unacceptable” and warning that it further strained already sensitive bilateral relations.
